facts.fact: The Moroccan banking mediation centre Al Wassit Albanki, set up under Bank Al-Maghrib, received 5,536 complaint files in 2024, of which disputes over payment means (cards 57.35%, transfers 29.08%) were 21.16% of those treated, and payment institutions and money transfer companies were among the institutions concerned.
facts.system: Al Wassit Albanki (Centre Marocain de Mediation Bancaire)

note: Complaint figures cover all credit institutions, so no enforcement fact is recorded.
